These areas are not reported for a separate South Sudan territory. The 2018 South Sudan CBD strategy uses different areas/classifications and includes proposed changes. The yearbook notes that the reported percentage excludes maritime area. This is a broader all-category terrestrial-protection aggregate for the Taiwan-Fuchien scope, not a national-parks-only value; it remains separate from the end-of-2001 park inventory.
national_park_notes: The official end-of-2001 park profile lists 18,083 ha of Kenting land, 15,186 ha of Kenting marine area, and land areas of 105,491 ha Yushan, 11,455 ha Yangmingshan, 92,000 ha Taroko, 76,850 ha Sheipa, and 3,780 ha Kinmen. Excluding Kenting's marine row gives 307,659 ha = 3,076.59 km2. The official 2001 land-area denominator is 36,188.04 km2; the derived parks-only land share is 8.5017%. This is not the broader UNSD all-category protected-area metric.
